correctness.rationale: The normalization computation is reconstructed: the exponent semigroup omits only the linear v monomial, hence R=C⊕Cu⊕(u,v)^2, B=C[u,v], and conductor (u,v^2). Every R automorphism extends uniquely to B, preserves the conductor radical (u,v), and its first coordinate has no linear v term. Conversely a polynomial plane automorphism fixing 0 with a lower-triangular invertible derivative preserves R and its inverse preserves R, proving the exact group rather than merely a subgroup. The differential map splits by linear automorphisms; conjugation by scalar dilation gives polynomial families to their first jets and the connected Borel supplies connectedness. The allowed u→u+v² shear moves any punctured v-axis point off the axis, proving two orbits. The pinned verify.py was inspected: it symbolically checks the presentation/monomials and concrete automorphisms, not the infinite automorphism theorem. Independently checked all semigroup exponents in 0..12 except (0,1); the unbounded classification follows from the above arguments, not this finite check.
